records.name: hero
records.prompt: Create ONE production game sprite PNG, transparent background. Original cute casual MECHA spaceship for a Korean mobile action game. Mandatory aesthetic: VERY THICK BLACK INK OUTLINES, CHUNKY CHIBI TOY MECHANIC, flat cartoon, simple large color blocks, TWO tones per material, no gradients. This is a tiny plump flying robot ship, not a slender fighter jet. Top-down view nose pointing up. Width roughly equals height. Fat rounded ivory capsule fuselage, enormous single blue oval canopy, stubby orange fins, two oversized round blue engine pods, two short cyan exhaust puffs. At most 10 large visible components, no tiny panel lines, no bolts, no textures, no metallic reflections, no realistic lighting, no complex facets. Strong black 12-18px outer ink at 1024px, bold internal ink. Friendly squat silhouette like a chunky cartoon toy, readable as a 48px icon. Subject centered with generous 15 percent clear padding on EVERY side. Whole ship fully visible including exhaust. No text, no UI frame, no ground shadow, no backdrop. Do not imitate any existing named character. Prioritize simple adorable mechanical forms.

records.name: backdrop
records.prompt: Production mobile casual game background, portrait 2:3 aspect. Very simple flat orange comic paper backdrop. Solid warm tangerine orange, broad yellow orange patch in lower center, very subtle sparse lighter halftone dots and a few faint simple gear silhouettes at outer edges only. Center 70 percent almost empty solid orange. Flat two-dimensional screen-print graphic, no scenery, no platform, no characters, no objects, no text, no UI, no borders, no perspective, no gradients, no rendered lights, no metallic details. Warm cheerful toy mechanic game mood, background must be quiet so outlined chunky sprites and black edged yellow buttons placed later are legible. Fill the canvas completely, fully opaque.
